name: MBS Fabrications

Our staff bring a strong combination of skills and experience in these and other areas to produce precise and well constructed pieces efficiently.
about:
MBS Fabrication, Inc. operates from Southbridge, Massachusetts, where it was founded in 1997 as a woman-owned business. The company began with a focus on precision sheet metal work and has grown into a specialist in close-tolerance fabrication, forming, and machining.

The shop combines CNC machining, welding, and sheet metal fabrication to produce precision components and sub-assemblies such as cap and baffle assemblies, tube and housing sub-assemblies, dynamic plate sub-assemblies, and effusion plate sub-assemblies. Its quality assurance personnel inspect every part to verify conformance to customer requirements, drawing on a team whose combined experience exceeds 100 years.

While the company serves customers large and small, its certifications — ISO 9001:2015, AS9100:2016, and NADCAP for nonconventional machining and welding — indicate a strong orientation toward aerospace and defense supply chains. The product portfolio reflects the complex, high-reliability assemblies typical of those sectors.

MBS states its mission is to create products held to the highest standards, meet or exceed customer expectations, continuously improve, and deliver jobs on time, every time. This commitment to craftsmanship and timeliness has been the foundation of its reputation for over 25 years.
